items.exampleEn: The view from the top was incredibly beautiful.
items.exampleZh: 從山頂看出去的景色美得令人難以置信。

items.exampleEn: I'm terribly sorry for being late.
items.exampleZh: 我遲到了，真的非常抱歉。

items.exampleEn: After two weeks of intensive training, he was ready for the race.
items.exampleZh: 經過兩週的密集訓練，他準備好參加比賽了。

items.exampleEn: I have told him countless times to lock the door.
items.exampleZh: 我已經跟他說過無數次要鎖門。

items.exampleEn: The table has a diameter of one meter.
items.exampleZh: 這張桌子的直徑是一公尺。

items.exampleEn: This forest has an abundance of wild birds.
items.exampleZh: 這座森林有大量的野鳥。

items.exampleEn: There is an excess of sugar in many drinks.
items.exampleZh: 很多飲料含有過多的糖。

items.sentenceEn: I'm terribly busy this week, so let's meet next week.
items.sentenceZh: 我這星期忙得不得了，我們下星期再見面吧。

items.audioEn: The wheel has a diameter of seventy centimeters.
items.audioZh: 這個輪子的直徑是七十公分。
items.questionZh: 這個輪子的直徑是多少？

items.sentenceEn: The company runs an intensive training program for new staff.
items.sentenceZh: 公司為新進員工辦了一個密集的訓練課程。

items.sentenceEn: There are countless stars in the night sky.
items.sentenceZh: 夜空中有數不清的星星。

items.stemEn: The movie was ____ funny; everyone laughed the whole time.
items.stemZh: 這部電影好笑得不得了，大家從頭笑到尾。

items.stemEn: The market sells fruit in ____ during the summer.
items.stemZh: 夏天時市場裡有大量的水果。

items.passageEn: Mr. Lin owns an orange farm in southern Taiwan. This year, the weather was incredibly good, and there is an abundance of fruit. But this has also caused a problem: an excess of oranges means prices become terribly low. So Mr. Lin took an intensive online course on selling directly to customers. Since then, he has received countless orders. He even sells his oranges by size: each one has a diameter of at least eight centimeters.
items.passageZh: 林先生在台灣南部有一座柳丁園。今年天氣好得不得了，水果收成非常豐富。但這也造成一個問題：柳丁太多，價格就會變得非常低。所以林先生上了一門關於直接賣給顧客的線上密集課程。從那時起，他接到了無數的訂單。他甚至按大小賣柳丁：每顆直徑至少八公分。

questions.questionZh: 今年柳丁收成多，造成了什麼問題？
林先生怎麼解決這個問題？

items.promptZh: 我真的非常抱歉讓你等這麼久。
referenceEn: I'm terribly sorry to keep you waiting so long.
I am terribly sorry that you had to wait so long.
rubricZh: terribly 在這裡表示「非常」，例如 terribly sorry 等說法
「讓你等」可寫 keep you waiting、you had to wait 等
「這麼久」可寫 so long、for so long 等

items.promptZh: 這座圖書館有數不清的舊書。
referenceEn: This library has countless old books.
There are countless old books in this library.
rubricZh: 用 countless 表示「數不清的」（例如 countless old books）
